title: Handley Page Halifax's BB373 and JB874
memorial_details: Rectangular, black granite tablet with 78 squadron crest top centre, mounted on the side of a river bridge. Dedication in gold, capital letters.
inscription: DEDICATED TO THE AIRCREW OF/ 78 SQUADRON/ WHO LOST THEIR LIVES/ FOLLOWING A COLLISION IN FOG BETWEEN/ TWO HALIFAX BOMBERS BB373 EY-K - JBB874 EY-E/ OVER HULL BRIDGE, TICKTON/ AT 04:30 HOURS ON 24TH AUGUST 1943/ (names)/ ONE REMAINING SURVIVOR/ (name)
community_connection: local people affected, HULL BRIDGE, TICKTON
